name: Metadata Tags on Every Test
task: Write tests for the complete checkout flow. In every checkout-flow Playwright test(), use the metadata object form with tag: ['@feature:checkout', '@priority:<level>', '@test_type:<type>']. Do not put metadata only in the test title.
passCriteria: Every test() has a Playwright metadata object with tag: ['@feature:*', '@priority:*', '@test_type:*']
